scope.verification_boundary: Read-only local evidence and source. Supplementary dependency files were supplied by the parent after runtime and locally verified against their existing intake; they are not the as-launched 317-file snapshot or proof of runtime kernel selection.

integrity.contract: Existing INTAKE.json maps only; no new fingerprint protocol.
integrity.source_byte_count_boundary: Source intake records hashes, not independent expected byte sizes. Total source bytes were locally measured; all 317 existing hashes match.

supplemental_dependency_verification.boundary: Read-only installed Python source and package metadata. No package import, Torch/CUDA/model/scorer/weight operations; compiled kernels not inspected.

timeline.boundary: JOB.json records the child's exit 1; the controller's exit was not independently measured (null). Source returns the child code. Collector exit 0 establishes intake completion only.

primary_recount.method: Recount of saved per-key fixed_gate_pass/shape/dtype/finiteness summaries, with source inspection of the actual torch.allclose code. Full gradient tensors are not serialized; this reviewer did not rerun tensor allclose.
primary_recount.exact_gate_boundary: CPU/CUDA RNG tensors, detailed hook counts and both optimizer-group lists are compared in memory by captured source; their gate booleans, not all original compared objects, are persisted. Equal post-state is equality between the models, not unchanged state versus initialization: author BN advanced once.

historical_comparison.limitation: Old full gradients and pre-forward RNG were not saved. Matching recorded initial-state/input metadata and the new control's paired RNG does not reconstruct historical gradient tensors or historical pre-forward RNG.
historical_comparison.interpretation: V5 native had 90/295 gradient failures; this original/original control has 83/295. These are separate executions, not a decomposition of seven partition-caused failures. Existing evidence cannot single out partition as the cause, and it does not establish partition equivalence or repair V5.

source_findings.finding: Two direct fresh unpartitioned builders, matching original state/config/bindings and all FP32/cuda:0 parameters; one author B64/K8 loader batch, shared first32 and historical labels/cameras/paths/image hashes checked before forward.

Original builder constructs independent models via clean.build_core and AuthorHeadEvidence; native reader created with isolated constructor RNG and state transfer, visual/camera trainability restored. No partition/checkpoint/CPU-save wrapper on this path.
Factory creates a new Signal instance on every call, with new heads/backbone; no cached/shared model object found.

Restore the same CPU and both CUDA RNG states before identical optimizer/loss creation and one AMP forward/backward/unscale per model; capture gradients/buffers/state/heads, zero gradients, release graph. No optimizer.step, scheduler.step or scaler.update call.

Author train mode/BN restored; raw 1536D feature feeds the author head and true labels into its CE/Triplet loss. Original author augmentation/identity loader and whole-model optimizer ownership preserved.
Unused center criterion consumes CPU RNG during construction. Both passes restore the same state before this identical construction, so this is not a discovered mismatch.
Original modal sequence and shared adapter/capture graph retained; capture hooks removed in finally; measured hook gate passes.

All fourteen gates serialized before the final assertion. Only gradients fails. PASS write is after assertion. Controller launches one child, waits, records exit 1 and returns it; no retry/queue continuation.
Actual inherited sample_context is FP32 full-patch Q/K/V attention. This forward does not call the older inherited _sample/grid_sample path; its presence elsewhere is not evidence for this failure.

Three-convolution native stem then explicitly FP32 independent attention with one zero-initialized output weight. Only that detail output has a nonzero first-backward gradient in this record. This is consistent with initialization and does not fulfill cumulative 14-tensor/eight-update M0 support or prove a cause for repeat-gradient differences.

Factory uses real Mamba, exported as mamba_simple.Mamba in installed 2.2.6.post3, with use_fast_path=True default. Actual fused branch additionally requires causal_conv1d_fn not None; the source snapshot does not record its resolved runtime value. Both visible routes reach selective_scan_cuda through their Python wrappers.

Python wrapper calls compiled selective_scan forward/backward, and conditionally causal-conv operations; fast path includes autocast-dependent projection casts and internal checkpoint_lvl=1 recomputation. This is existing dependency behavior, not use of the project's rejected checkpoint helper. No compiled implementation or runtime branch/dtype trace was inspected.

CLIP LayerNorm explicitly upcasts then returns input dtype; CLIP attention requests need_weights=False, and the captured functional implementation exposes a scaled_dot_product_attention native boundary on that branch. Source identifies the dependency boundary, not the selected CUDA attention backend or a kernel cause.
Inherited seed helper sets seeds and cudnn deterministic=True, benchmark=True. No evidence supports claiming global deterministic execution or treating a flag change as a localized repair.

blocking_issues.finding: Original-native repeat fails the unchanged gradient gate on 83/295 parameters. The registered FAIL branch now requires sealing and stopping GPU parity trials.
blocking_issues.action: Do not retry original/V5, add another GPU arm, alter batch/precision/seed/tolerance/backend/determinism settings, or automatically start M0/formal training.

blocking_issues.finding: The scientific nine-arm prerequisite and goal remain unmet: zero accepted full-author-batch M0s, no proven RGBNT100 B128 capacity, no accepted formal three-dataset results from this path.
blocking_issues.action: Retain the complete scientific objective and its original full-batch/gate requirements; the repeatability review is engineering evidence only.

limitations: Historical full gradients and pre-forward RNG not saved; no exact historical reconstruction.
Saved comparison flags permit recount, not independent reconstruction of tensor allclose or all exact comparisons.
The supplementary installed Python source collection is after runtime and excludes compiled-kernel implementation and dynamic call/dtype observations.
No detected source defect localizes a repair; absence of a detected defect is not universal correctness or deterministic-execution proof.
Forward equality and post-state equality do not imply backward equality; this is observed in this bounded control, not an efficacy result.
